import base64
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import sys

campaign = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = campaign / "source"
os.chdir(source)
feature = source / "compiler/Fixtures/FeatureProbe/replay.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("feature_replay", feature)
replay = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(replay)

resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE, (0, 0))
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (256 * 1024**2, 256 * 1024**2))
build = campaign / "build"
build.mkdir()
run = replay.Run(build)
pin = "7d257e0d1beda17874fc0ce7d015d81bf640870a"
tree = "5d13c046a6a3aed8cce7632578c19e0c48cf01ee"
preview = campaign / "TitlePreview.swift"
host = campaign / "TitleHost.swift"
adapter = feature.with_name("CompactPreviewGuest.swift")
alternate_adapter = build / adapter.name
original_adapter = adapter.read_text()
needle = "private typealias Preview = FloatingPointPreview"
replay.require(original_adapter.count(needle) == 1, "adapter alias drift")
alternate_adapter.write_text(original_adapter.replace(needle, "private typealias Preview = TitlePreview"))
receipt = {
    "gate": "L03 §7.3",
    "startedUTC": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "publicRevision": pin, "publicTree": tree,
    "scope": "Unsigned fixed-width synthetic FieldLog title-change preview on arm64 macOS. Guest UI V1 compact ABI, owned VM, table-memory-v3, 1 page, 1,000,000 fuel per event, zero host calls. ASCII edge whitespace domain (HT–CR and space); byte counts and Unicode scalar counts, with no normalization or grapheme counts. No installed FieldLog, signing, devices, or general guest Foundation/String qualification.",
    "layout": {
        "input": "action byte 1, title byte length, up to 32 title bytes with zero padding",
        "frame": "trimmed title byte length, scalar count, exact trimmed bytes, zero padding to 34",
        "initial": "34 zero bytes",
    },
    "pinnedReplay": {str(path.relative_to(source)): replay.identity(path) for path in
        [feature, adapter, replay.BENCHMARK / "matched_task.py", replay.BENCHMARK / "MatchedTask.swift",
         replay.INSTALLED / "run.py", replay.INSTALLED / "replay_abi.py"]},
    "fixtureHashes": {path.name: replay.identity(path) for path in
        [preview, host, alternate_adapter, Path(__file__).resolve()]},
}
initial = bytes(34)
def event(payload, action=1):
    return bytes([action, len(payload)]) + payload.ljust(32, b"\0")

def frame(raw_hex, scalar_count):
    payload = bytes.fromhex(raw_hex)
    return bytes([len(payload), scalar_count]) + payload.ljust(32, b"\0")

decomposed = frame("43616665cc81", 5)
arabic = frame("d985d8b1d8add8a8d8a7", 5)
emoji = frame("65cc8120f09f91a9e2808df09f92bb", 6)
short = frame("f09fa7aa", 1)
arabic_payload = bytes.fromhex("d985d8b1d8add8a8d8a7")
emoji_payload = bytes.fromhex("65cc8120f09f91a9e2808df09f92bb")
# Expected frame bytes and scalar counts are authored independently of either replay path.
ordered = [
    ("decomposed-accent", event(b" \tCafe\xcc\x81\r\n"), True, decomposed),
    ("bad-action", event(b"other", 2), False, decomposed),
    ("short-envelope", event(b"other")[:-1], False, decomposed),
    ("declared-length-over-capacity", bytes([1, 33]) + bytes(32), False, decomposed),
    ("nonzero-padding", event(b"a")[:-1] + b"\x01", False, decomposed),
    ("arabic", event(b"\n" + arabic_payload + b" "), True, arabic),
    ("empty-title", event(b""), False, arabic),
    ("blank-title", event(b" \t\r\n "), False, arabic),
    ("orphan-continuation", event(b"A\x80"), False, arabic),
    ("overlong-encoding", event(b"\xc0\xaf"), False, arabic),
    ("utf16-surrogate", event(b"\xed\xa0\x80"), False, arabic),
    ("above-unicode-maximum", event(b"\xf4\x90\x80\x80"), False, arabic),
    ("bad-continuation", event(b"\xe2\x28\xa1"), False, arabic),
    ("accent-and-emoji-zwj", event(b"  " + emoji_payload + b"\t"), True, emoji),
    ("truncated-four-byte-scalar", event(b"\xf0\x9f\xa7"), False, emoji),
    ("emoji-after-refusal", event(b"\t\xf0\x9f\xa7\xaa "), True, short),
]
b64 = lambda data: base64.b64encode(data).decode()
cases = build / "events.json"
cases.write_text(json.dumps([dict(name=name, input=b64(data), accepts=accept, frame=b64(expected))
                             for name, data, accept, expected in ordered]))
receipt["events"] = [dict(name=name, inputHex=data.hex(), expectedFrameHex=expected.hex(), accepts=accept)
                     for name, data, accept, expected in ordered]
call = run.command
native_options = ("-O", "-swift-version", "6", "-parse-as-library", "-module-cache-path", build / "native-modules")
guest_options = ("-module-cache-path", build / "guest-modules")

def observe(label, *argv, owned=False):
    output = json.loads(call(label, *argv)[0])
    replay.require(output["retiredAndReclaimed"] is owned and output["initial"] == b64(initial),
                   f"{label}: initial frame or retirement")
    replay.require(len(output["events"]) == len(ordered), f"{label}: event count")
    fuels = {}
    actual_frames = {}
    for actual, (name, _, accepts, expected) in zip(output["events"], ordered, strict=True):
        fuel = actual.pop("fuel", None)
        replay.require(actual == dict(name=name, accepted=accepts, frame=b64(expected)),
                       f"{label}: event {name} changed from its exact oracle")
        actual_frames[name] = base64.b64decode(actual["frame"], validate=True).hex()
        replay.require(0 < fuel <= 1_000_000 if owned else fuel is None, f"{label}: invalid fuel")
        if owned:
            fuels[name] = fuel
    result = dict(exactFramesAndDecisions=True, initialFrameHex=initial.hex(),
                  accepted=sum(row[2] for row in ordered), refused=sum(not row[2] for row in ordered),
                  retiredAndReclaimed=owned, observedFramesHex=actual_frames)
    if owned:
        result["fuelPerEvent"] = fuels
    receipt[label] = result

def run_campaign():
    commands = {
        "macOS": ("/usr/bin/sw_vers",),
        "nativeSwift": ("/usr/bin/swiftc", "--version"),
        "guestSwift": (run.swift / "swiftc", "--version"),
        "linker": (run.swift / "wasm-ld", "--version"),
        "rustc": (run.rust / "rustc", "--version"),
        "cargo": (run.rust / "cargo", "--version"),
    }
    receipt["tools"] = {name: call(name, *argv)[0].strip() for name, argv in commands.items()}
    replay.require("6.3.3" in receipt["tools"]["guestSwift"], "incorrect guest toolchain")
    for target, flag in (("foundation", "TITLE_FOUNDATION"), ("stdlib-string", "TITLE_STRING")):
        binary = build / ("native-" + target)
        call(target + "-native-build", "/usr/bin/swiftc", *native_options, "-D", flag, host, preview,
             "-o", binary, bound=30)
        observe(target + "-native", binary, cases)

    # Deliberately compile both the exact Foundation path and the equivalent
    # standard-library String/Unicode path, so import failure cannot mask String.
    diagnostics = receipt["embeddedAttempts"] = {}
    candidates = []
    for target, flag, expected_error in (
        ("foundation", "TITLE_FOUNDATION", "no such module 'Foundation'"),
        ("stdlib-string", "TITLE_STRING", "unavailable"),
    ):
        variant = target + "-guest"
        command = (replay.stock_allocator_guest_command(run, receipt) if target == "stdlib-string"
                   else lambda *args: call(*args, bound=35))
        try:
            wasm = replay.build_compact_guest(command, run.swift, build, variant, [preview, alternate_adapter],
                                              flags=(*guest_options, "-D", flag))
        except ValueError as error:
            label = variant + "-swift"
            stderr = build / (label + ".err")
            if (run.active is not None or not run.commands or run.commands[-1]["label"] != label
                    or run.commands[-1]["exit"] != 1 or not stderr.is_file() or "stop=None" not in str(error)):
                raise
            detail = stderr.read_text()
            diagnostics[target] = dict(compiled=False, exit=1, diagnostic=detail.replace(str(campaign), "$CAMPAIGN"),
                                       objectEmitted=(build / (variant + ".o")).exists())
            print(f"{target} guest compiler refused: {detail.splitlines()[0]}", flush=True)
            replay.require(expected_error in detail and not diagnostics[target]["objectEmitted"],
                           f"{target}: unexpected compiler diagnosis: {error}")
        else:
            diagnostics[target] = dict(compiled=True, artifact=replay.identity(wasm))
            print(f"{target} guest object compiled and linked", flush=True)
            candidates.append((target, wasm))
    if not candidates:
        wasm = replay.build_compact_guest(lambda *args: call(*args, bound=35), run.swift, build,
                                          "byte-title", [preview, alternate_adapter], flags=guest_options)
        candidates.append(("byte-title", wasm))

    owned_sources = [host, *replay.compact_host_sources()[1:]]
    archive = replay.build_compact_host(run, owned_sources, fixture_flags=("-D", "TITLE_OWNED_HOST"))
    receipt["vmArchive"] = replay.identity(archive)
    receipt["hostExecutable"] = replay.identity(build / "compact-host")
    for target, wasm in candidates:
        descriptors = replay.replay_abi.check_descriptors(wasm.read_bytes())
        receipt.setdefault("guestArtifacts", {})[target] = dict(
            **replay.identity(wasm), imports=descriptors["imports"], memories=descriptors["memories"],
            startFunction=descriptors["startFunction"], exports=descriptors["exports"])
        observe(target + "-owned-vm", build / "compact-host", cases, wasm, owned=True)
    receipt["result"] = ("passed-scoped-byte-fallback" if candidates[0][0] == "byte-title"
                         else "passed-scoped-guest-string")

try:
    run_campaign()
except Exception as error:
    receipt["result"] = "incomplete"
    receipt["failure"] = repr(error)
    raise
finally:
    receipt["commands"] = run.commands
    receipt["custody"] = dict(directReapedAndGroupsObservedAbsent=len(run.commands), unknown=run.active,
                              peakBuildBytes=run.peak_scratch, buildLimitBytes=replay.SCRATCH_LIMIT)
    receipt["finishedUTC"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    (campaign / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
